success_criteria: After §5.4 fix applied: header reflows correctly in §5.5 configuration (right TodoList sidebar open, narrower desktop ~800–960 px total window width)
Logo and avatar track the main-column boundary, not window edges

constraints: No code changes in this pipeline — dev work is fully owned by §5.4 ba-spec-20260424-143000-11.md

root_cause_analysis.symptom: Top-bar happy logo and avatar are anchored to window edges rather than main-column boundaries when right sidebar (TodoList panel) is open in a narrower desktop viewport. Header title is not centered in the available column space.
root_cause_analysis.root_cause: Same root cause as §5.4: layout.headerMaxWidth is a static clamp that does not track main-column width changes, and MainView.tsx sidebarContentContainer has no awareness of the right sidebar open/close state that would feed back to the header. RightSidebar is fixed at SIDEBAR_WIDTH=450px with no reactive signal to the header.
root_cause_analysis.root_cause_commit: N/A — static layout design, not introduced by a specific regression commit
root_cause_analysis.why_introduced: Header was designed with a static max-width clamp without anticipating dynamic sidebar reservation
root_cause_analysis.why_problematic: When the right sidebar (450px fixed) is open in a narrower viewport, the main column may be as small as 460–480px, making the misalignment visually prominent and potentially causing elements to overlap
root_cause_analysis.timeline: Present since initial header/sidebar design; no regression
observations: Screenshot 9d264db4-cc7e-4fc4-abf7-d5f5e393d635-4132.png shows: right sidebar open with TodoList items; header title 'Redesign /spec command' appears left-shifted; logo H top-left and avatar top-right are anchored to window edges not column edges (inferred from screenshot visual analysis)
Sidebar content in §5.5 is TodoList panel, not Bash popup as in §5.4 — different trigger path but same structural issue
root_cause_analysis.diagnosis_completeness: incomplete (inferred only — no DevTools getComputedStyle measurement performed; runtime verification deferred to QA)
root_cause_analysis.localization_evidence: Screenshot 4132.png reviewed directly. Right sidebar open (TodoList), narrower viewport. Header elements visible at window edges, not at main-column edges. Same structural pattern as §5.4.
root_cause_analysis.located_source: packages/happy-app/sources/components/navigation/Header.tsx (layout.headerMaxWidth static clamp) + packages/happy-app/sources/components/RightSidebar.tsx (SIDEBAR_WIDTH=450 fixed, no reactive signal to header)
